dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset comprises the geological polygon features of Map 180, Geology of the Precambrian Shield in northeastern Alberta, NTS 74M and NTS 74L, published by the Alberta Geological Survey (polygon features). The data are created in ArcInfo and output for public distribution in shapefile format.
dct_title_s: Geology of the Precambrian Shield in northeastern Alberta, NTS 74M and NTS 74L -bedrock polygons (GIS data, polygon features)
